# WCS Building Services

> A father-and-son domestic building firm based in Axminster, East Devon.
> WCS builds extensions, loft and barn conversions, kitchens, driveways, and
> bespoke and heritage ("pre-historic") projects across East Devon.

## Key facts
- Business: WCS Building Services (also "WCS Builders")
- Owners: William (Will) Skilton and Charley Skilton — a father-and-son team
- Experience: over 40 years in construction
- Based in: Axminster, Devon
- Service area: Axminster, East Devon and surrounding areas, including Lyme Regis
- Fully insured
- Free, no-obligation quotes — typically returned within 5 working days
- Phone / text: 07739 084929
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/wcsbuildingservices/
- Website: https://wcsbuildingservices.co.uk

## Services
- Extensions — front, rear, side, two-storey, wrap-around and over-garage extensions
- Loft conversions — bedrooms, studios, home offices, hangouts and gyms
- Kitchens — kitchen design and fitting
- Barn conversions — agricultural buildings converted to homes, compliant with building regulations
- Driveways — new and reconfigured driveways, including block paving
- Bespoke projects — one-off and unusual builds
- Pre-historic / heritage builds — restoration of historic buildings
